mission.goal: Deliver a FUSE-owned authenticated Windows processing relay and direct OpenAI Secure MCP Tunnel profile with no Remote Desktop Commander production dependency.
mission.workflow: ChatGPT -> OpenAI Secure MCP Tunnel -> private stdio MCP -> Windows policy gate -> hash-bound receipt; canonical cloud-relay route remains available
mission.data: privacy-minimized task envelope, bounded result and receipt; no secrets or raw private evidence
mission.interface: Private stdio MCP, Streamable HTTP MCP, signed agent HTTPS routes, Python CLI, current-user PowerShell supervisor and GitHub Actions workflow
mission.stack: Python 3.11+, MCP Python SDK v2, Firestore, Cloud Run, OAuth 2.1/OIDC, PowerShell 7, Windows, GitHub Actions
mission.environment: Google Cloud Run relay plus outbound Windows 11 agent; GitHub-hosted windows-latest remains the ephemeral validation plane
mission.governance: FUSE parent; N-OMEGA continuation; Formation/SOVARA/FDOF authority; SOL 6.2 recovery; ProofOS/RealityGuard proof
mission.testing: unit, source integration, Windows hosted smoke, permission and path boundary tests
mission.deployment: FDOF-fenced GitHub PR followed by Windows workflow job and artifact readback
mission.continuity: receipt identity, source SHA, correlation ID, bounded task TTL, idempotent read-only effects and handoff files

assumptions.runtime: Cloud Run is the relay; the owner workstation connects outbound and retains no inbound listener
assumptions.storage: Firestore holds transactional enrollment, device, nonce, lease, task and receipt state; deployment receipts are immutable workflow artifacts
assumptions.authentication: ChatGPT uses exact-issuer/audience OAuth tokens; the workstation uses HMAC signed requests and a DPAPI-protected device credential; GitHub deploys through OIDC/WIF
assumptions.deployment: The repository admits changes through an FDOF-fenced pull request and proves them on windows-latest

components.backend: FUSE private stdio and hosted MCP servers plus signed agent transport and the shared federation_windows_plane execution core
components.worker: Outbound-only owner Windows agent; GitHub-hosted Windows remains a validation runner
components.scheduler: Windows Task Scheduler limited current-user logon trigger supervises the direct tunnel client; no task-work scheduler is introduced
components.storage: Firestore operational state plus bounded immutable deployment receipt artifact
components.authentication: OpenAI tunnel identity plus scoped runtime key for private stdio; OAuth 2.1/OIDC for hosted MCP; one-time enrollment and signed device identity for the relay agent; GitHub OIDC/WIF for deployment

observability.correlation_ids: task_id plus correlation_id plus GitHub run and attempt
observability.health_checks: health task and Windows semantic verification step
observability.structured_logs: JSON CLI output and failure output
observability.audit_logs: GitHub job plus immutable receipt artifact
observability.metrics_alerts: workflow conclusion, duration and receipt fields; alerts remain existing GitHub notifications

testing.e2e_or_smoke: FUSE Windows Execution Plane v1 workflow health task
testing.failure_first: wrong OAuth audience, missing DPAPI, signature body tamper, replay, expiry, issuer, effect, unknown task, unknown field, absolute path and path escape

deploy_commands: source-admit through FDOF-fenced pull request; create owner-only dispatch issue titled [FO-DISPATCH] FUSE_WINDOWS_RELAY_CLOUD_RUN_V1
rollback_commands: workflow restores the previous Cloud Run revision on failed canary; direct tunnel uses Repair-FuseWindowsTunnel.ps1 -Action Rollback; source rollback is a revert

watchman.unavailable_capability: an admitted OAuth issuer/client configuration and first owner-workstation enrollment
watchman.safe_substitute: source-complete relay plus GitHub-hosted Windows validation
watchman.closure_test: authenticated ChatGPT tool call, owner-workstation heartbeat and exact task receipt independently read back

continuity.idempotency: read-only operations are idempotent in effect; task and correlation IDs plus TTL bound retries without claiming durable replay prevention
continuity.checkpoints: source SHA, job ID, attempt, artifact ID, task SHA and result SHA
continuity.resume_conditions: fresh main/FDOF plus terminal prior job state
continuity.stop_switch: owner stop, stale mission, FDOF collision, test failure, unexpected effect or receipt mismatch
